practicals.title: Experiment 1
content: Draw an organization structure / hierarchy of a government
organisation related to construction field after referring Government
of India online directory (iGOD)

practicals.title: Experiment 2
content: Mind mapping of the SWOT or SWOC analysis of a construction
project of a company

practicals.title: Experiment 3
content: Project Case Study report: List the reasons of project failure along
with feasible solution of a given case study

practicals.title: Experiment 4
content: Summary report on a given tender or contract though an authentic
source

practicals.title: Experiment 5
content: Examples on CPM methods

practicals.title: Experiment 6
content: Examples on PERT methods

practicals.title: Experiment 7
content: Conduct a comprehensive financial analysis of the annual statement
of a construction company, focusing specifically on projects
involving Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), such as the Delhi Metro
Atal Tunnel, and Ahmedabad BRTS

practicals.title: Experiment 8
content: ABC analysis for material classification after procuring the material
form an online platform

practicals.title: Experiment 9
content: Mind mapping of a construction labour laws / acts in India

practicals.title: Experiment 10
content: The topic of the Seminar shall be given to a group of students or on
an individual basis. The students are required to submit and
present/defend the Seminar in the presence of students and teachers
and the report including a PowerPoint presentation to be attached
with the submission. Each individual student’s contribution to group
work needs to be made explicit
Total Hours 28
